label: D1 after a1->S1 trial; strongest if unrewarded, early episode, a1-leaning policy
terms: (phase == D1) ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 u") ;; (phase == D1) * last_is("a1 S1 r") ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state == 1) * (tv("action", -2) == 1) * (tv("state", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state == 1) * ep_dec ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state == 1) * choice ;; (phase == D1) * (prev_action == 1) * (prev_state == 1) * np.abs(choice)
explanation: Active only at D1, and essentially only after a previous trial of a1 reaching S1 (common). Magnitude is largest after a1 S1 unrewarded (~1.0-1.1) and moderate after a1 S1 rewarded (~0.3-0.6, rising over consecutive a1->S1 trials); it is raised when the trial before was also a1->S1 and decays across the episode (ep_dec slope within a1 S1). Beyond the history, the model policy logit at D1 (choice, a model output, not a future variable) explains extra variance: magnitude tracks the a1-vs-a2 preference after a1 S1. Other previous-trial patterns (a2 or S2) give ~0 (the timing baseline over-predicts them; a general D1 term corrects that). No GO/D2 activity. Scores beyond timing: observed-history-only terms ~0.39 dev; with the policy-logit terms 0.47 dev / 0.47 test vs all ceiling 0.49 (all observed 0.38). Remaining misses are mostly the window first trial where the previous trial is unknown.

issues: The label's 'a1-leaning policy' gets the sign wrong. Among D1 steps after a1->S1, a stronger a1 policy logit LOWERS the feature. With history terms only, the A1S1*choice weight is -0.077. In the original fit the choice term (+0.039) and |choice| term (-0.127) add up to a net negative slope for choice > 0. Binned: A1S1*(choice>3) has weight -0.205 and A1S1*(choice<1) -0.049. The profile's policy deciles agree (D1 decile 6 +0.177, decile 7 +0.106, decile 8 -0.064), so the feature peaks at a MODERATE a1 preference, not the strongest one.

A history factor is missing. After a1->S1 the feature is lower when the trial before that was unrewarded. Adding A1S1*(tv('reward',-2)==0) gives weight -0.158. Splitting it by outcome gives -0.30 after an a1 S1 u trial and -0.135 after an a1 S1 r trial. The misses output shows an a1 S1 r trial that followed an a1 S1 u trial with an actual value of 0 against a prediction of 0.47. With this term, history-only test R^2 rises from the claimed ~0.39 to 0.437, so the 'rising over consecutive a1->S1 trials' story is incomplete.

The window's first trial (previous trial unknown) is the largest systematic under-prediction: +0.049 mean error after '?'. Several of the worst misses are about 1.1 actual against 0.07-0.09 predicted. The explanation names this but adds no term, even though the agent can see the reward input there. (phase==D1)*(prev_action==-1)*(in_rew==0)*(choice>0) recovers part of it: test 0.472 -> 0.484.

These claims check out: active only at D1 (GO and D2 residuals are exactly 0); a1 S1 u > a1 S1 r (weights 0.77 vs 0.56); a positive weight when the trial before was also a1->S1 (+0.065); a decline with episode decile (-0.035); about 0 after other previous trials; the reproduced test R^2 of 0.4718. No future variables are used.
